method: Six independent hostile inspection agents over actual source/services/domain/components/tests/DB-sims/browser-specs/workflows; plus first-hand verification of safety invariants and a local Postgres-16 run of 7 execution DB sims (49 tests, all pass).
headlineFinding: OpsIQ has TWO worlds. (1) A genuine governed-execution substrate — the opportunity loop (intake->intelligence->validation->outcome->portfolio->OpportunityExecutionTask), the proof-integrity core (intake->precheck->completion-gate->adjudication->dispute->reassessment), the domain Finding->Action->/verify system, standing instructions, and atomic audit — all persisted, evidence-gated, owner-approval-gated, fail-closed, and CI/DB-proven. (2) A newer owner-facing 'process-intelligence' cockpit whose engines (process corrections, SOP correction, training assignment, effectiveness, workload reduction, cash/profit, capability gap) compute rich governed-LOOKING analyses that land in a read-only Now-View payload and render as display-only panels carrying approval labels and evidence-ID references — but persist no task, create no owner/manager/staff work item, and are NOT wired into the execution substrate that could act on them. The owner must manually re-key each diagnosis into the separate action forms. That missing bridge is the dominant execution-first gap.

safetyInvariantsVerifiedFirstHand.noUnsafeAutoExecution: PROVEN — approval-threshold-policy.ts NEVER_AUTO_ACTIONS (staff termination/payroll/misconduct/delete-audit/contract/loan/suppress-risk/scaling-on-unvalidated/legal/disciplinary) forced NEVER_AUTO even on thin data (:255-260); autonomy-policy canExecuteAutonomously=false for all levels; enforceOwnerActionGates throws ConflictError on every material transition; no consumer of autoExecutable performs any mutation.
safetyInvariantsVerifiedFirstHand.noFabricatedMoney: MOSTLY PROVEN — opportunity/validation/intake never fabricate money (real-or-null, DATA_INSUFFICIENT). TWO honesty defects found: (a) SOP/training effectiveness reports IMPROVED/'appears to be working' with no verifiably-executed correction; (b) cash/profit runway-days & margin-% metricValue are 5-value state-bucket constants presented as measured figures. Neither is currency/ROI/win-% fabrication, but both present synthesized values/claims as measured.
safetyInvariantsVerifiedFirstHand.workspaceIsolation: WRITE isolation proven (sec-04 empty-WHERE bulk-write backstop; sec-02 cross-tenant write -> NotFoundError). READ isolation NOT adversarially proven with two populated tenants.
safetyInvariantsVerifiedFirstHand.auditAtomicity: PROVEN for 2 operator-store paths (updateItem/applyOverride fault-injection rollback). 5 other governed write services rely on architectural claim, not fault-injection proof.
